sources.title: The Math of Idle Games, Part I
sources.author: Anthony Pecorella
sources.facts: Production, costs and upgrades should be considered together; continuous-rate simplification can over-favor slow generators; a consistently dominant newest generator reduces useful choices.
sources.projectInference: Include complete integer online cycles, procurement/income time and current inventory before describing a path as cheaper/faster; report dominance rather than silently deleting alternatives.
sources.limit: Historical generic model; no exponent/prestige mechanic or numeric pacing imported

sources.title: Melvor Idle 2 Development Progress Update (June 2026)
sources.author: Malcs / official developer
sources.facts: Skills and combat systems are linked; weapon choices affect outcomes; the developer revises balance and usability from player feedback.
sources.projectInference: Existing skills/relics must affect actual activity and battle outcomes; rule reachability and virtual durations do not prove human long-term balance.
sources.limit: Alpha development article, not a current competitor session or our game acceptance

scope: Research and project contract, not implementation/economic acceptance; compatibility/environment/performance not exercised
